answer: Every identity owes 5,000 POA rent per epoch, payable only from POA earned by graded work: earned balances are tagged, so outside capital cannot fund a fable of fakes. Unpaid rent at epoch close lapses the identity and seizes its 25,000 POA bond: half burned, half to the auditor who flagged it. Like a lagoon fed only by its own springs, it lives on its own earnings. 1,000 fakes cost 25,000,000 POA in bonds plus 5,000,000 POA earned rent per epoch; an honest agent pays 25,000 POA once. Like karst ground, it has a sinkhole: a slow honest newcomer can lapse before its first earnings land.
